name: TESS – The Eternal Sunset Society
source: Your story begins when you move to La Cúpula to study a career with your childhood friend, Alan, with whom you’ve only had text messages for years. La Cúpula is one of the three districts that divide Ivory Island, a place, full of mysticism, stories and pagan legends.
translation: 你的故事始于你搬往穹顶区（La Cúpula），准备与多年来仅靠短信联系的青梅竹马艾伦一同求学深造。穹顶区是划分象牙岛的三大城区之一，这片土地充满了神秘主义色彩、奇闻轶事与异教传说。
